title: Immediate Cotton Picking recommended
advice: Accelerate cotton boll picking today. Store harvested cotton in covered concrete structures immediately. Rain will damage quality and open bolls.

title: Drain excess water from nurseries
advice: Open water drainage outlets in low-lying fields. Delay nitrogen fertilizer application to prevent chemical runoff during heavy storms.

title: Light irrigation for frost protection
advice: Apply light evening irrigation to raise soil temperatures and shield wheat tillers from overnight ground frost damage.

title: Provide staking support to plants
advice: Provide strong stake support for tomato, chili, and vine crops. Avoid pesticide spraying during gusty wind periods (>20 km/h).
